title: 7. Asset Work Orders tab
note: Asset "shop heavy", opened from its current owner, Quartzsite Truck Service & Repair. It had an earlier owner, Kolosov's Diesel Repair. Left to right: the default view, the Customer chip open, one customer picked, applied, a 1600px board with search filled, then phone. Last row: the asset of S2-17579 (2024 INTERNATIONAL CV515, unit 854, Buda Truck Repair), where two work orders bill someone else, to show the "Bill To" column added after the tech review. Before: production v26.45.2.1. After: the locked Bill To build.

figures.heading: Work Orders tab, top
captions: A "Bill To" column sits right after Customer because a loaded row bills someone else. S2-17579 reads "Buda Truck Repair", "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair".
Self-billed rows leave the Bill To cell blank. Oldest first, as today.
At 1440 the extra column pushes the last columns past the right edge; the table scrolls sideways.
No production board for this asset: production was not re-run for this update. Production's tab has no Bill To column on any asset (see the "shop heavy" before board above).
Accuracy check: top bar identical to production; the tab toolbar differs from production only by the Customer chip (this build) and the Invoices count, which is this asset's data.
